evidences.evidence_context: A mixer eliminates the carrier wave in the received signal and uses a low-pass filter(LPF) to obtain the so-called intermediate frequency (IF) signal. The IF signal needs ADC sampling for digital signal processing. The IF signal can be expressed as[23]: IF(t)= T(t) ⨂ R(t) =cos(2π 2Sd c t + 4π(d+ d(t)) λ +4 πSd(t)t c −4πS(d+ d(t) c )^2 ) ≈ cos(2πft + ψ(t)) (3) where f = 2S c d is the frequency of the IF signal, which is proportional to d, λ = f0 c is the signal wavelength, and ψ(t) denotes the phase of the IF signal associated with micro-displacement.
